title: PluginManifest
description: Shape of plugins/<name>/plugin.yaml — the single source of truth for a plugin's identity, dependencies, declared access, and extension points (docs/001 §1).

schema.description: Manifest schema version. Always 1 for the docs/001 §1.1 shape.

name.description: Globally unique slug used as the plugin's identifier in logs, DB rows, and the plugin_<name_underscored> schema. The plugins/<name>/ directory MUST equal this value (docs/001 §1.2).

version.description: Plugin version, semver 2.0.0. MUST be strictly increasing across installed releases (docs/001 §1.2).

display_name.description: Human-facing label shown in the plugin admin UI.

description.description: One-paragraph summary shown in the plugin admin UI.

tier.description: Which bundle the plugin belongs to. Metadata only — access control is enforced at the GitHub repo level (docs/001 §1.2).

name.description: Slug of the bundle this plugin ships in. Used by `eidan admin plugin remove <bundle>` to scope a multi-plugin removal (docs/018 §3).

kind.description: Whether the bundle is a thematic bundle or the universal paid baseline. The CLI auto-removes baseline bundles when no thematic bundle remains installed (docs/018 §3).

bundle.description: Bundle membership metadata. Omitted for `tier: core` plugins that ship in this repo. Set on every plugin shipped in a paid bundle so the CLI can scope `plugin remove <bundle>` and reason about baseline auto-removal (docs/018 §3).

authors.description: Authors / maintainers, listed in the plugin admin UI.

depends_on.description: Other plugins required at load time. MUST form a DAG; cycles are a fatal load error (docs/001 §1.2).

host.description: Required host capabilities. Version strings are PEP 440 / npm-style ranges.

env.description: Env vars the plugin reads. Reading an undeclared env var raises UndeclaredAccessError (docs/001 §1.2).

key.description: Dotted vault key the plugin reads.

user_provided.description: The end user supplies this key per-user via the self-serve secrets API (docs/031), not the operator. Skipped by activation-time required-secret validation; writable only through POST /me/secrets.

vault.description: Vault keys the plugin reads. Reading an undeclared key raises UndeclaredAccessError (docs/001 §1.2).

entrypoint.description: Python module:ClassName tuple resolving to the Plugin subclass (docs/001 §2.2).

routes_prefix.description: URL prefix the plugin's FastAPI routers mount under (docs/001 §2.2).

backend.description: Backend extension point. Omitted when the plugin contributes no Python code.

package.description: Path to the plugin's web package, relative to the plugin root.

frontend.description: Frontend extension point. Omitted when the plugin contributes no UI.

dir.description: Path to the migrations directory, relative to the plugin root.

handler.description: Python module:function reference for the handler.

kind.description: Dispatch shape (docs/026). `llm_turn` (default) — host wraps the handler in the full run_turn loop. `tool_chain` — handler is a deterministic coroutine that calls tools directly. `classifier_gate` — coroutine plus one classifier call at a branch point. `notify` — no agent work, just emit a side effect. Additive: unset means `llm_turn` and behaves as today.

tools.description: Public allowlist of tool names externally exposed via MCP (docs/001 §7).

channel.description: Channel slug consumed by ctx.notify(channel=...). MUST be unique across all loaded plugins; the host registers each channel exactly once.

factory.description: Python entrypoint (module:function) of the adapter factory. The factory takes a SecretAccessor coroutine and returns a NotificationAdapter; the host calls it once at activation and registers the result on the process-local NotificationRouter.

notifications.description: Outbound notification adapters this plugin contributes (docs/001 §6, docs/024).
